instruction: I am an NLP researcher building a citation database. Search the ACL Anthology website for the best paper awards from 2019-2022 and add all four winning papers to the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. For each paper, record the title, year, complete author list (separated by commas), and the official ACL Anthology PDF link. Make sure to add exactly 4 entries.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
